title: Installation Date Booking Terms by Ridgeline Installation Services Program
content:
Each Ridgeline Installation Services program sets its own terms for booking and moving the installation date: what must be in place before a date is booked, how soon the date may be, the materials lead time quoted at signing, and the notice and count that keep a customer reschedule free.

## Booking terms

| Program | Materials must be received before booking | Issued permit required before booking (jobs that need a permit) | Earliest installation date (calendar days after the later of signing and materials receipt) | Typical materials lead time quoted at signing (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Carpet Installation | yes | no | 3 | 5 |
| Ridgeline Hard Surface Flooring Installation | yes | no | 3 | 7 |
| Ridgeline Window and Door Installation | yes | yes | 14 | 28 |
| Ridgeline Kitchen Cabinet and Countertop Installation | yes | yes | 21 | 42 |
| Ridgeline Bath Remodel Installation | yes | yes | 21 | 35 |
| Ridgeline Roofing and Siding Installation | yes | yes | 10 | 14 |

## Customer reschedule terms

| Program | Notice for a free reschedule (hours before the arrival window start) | Customer reschedules allowed before every further one carries the fee | Program reschedule fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Carpet Installation | 48 | 2 | 75.00 |
| Ridgeline Hard Surface Flooring Installation | 48 | 2 | 75.00 |
| Ridgeline Window and Door Installation | 72 | 2 | 125.00 |
| Ridgeline Kitchen Cabinet and Countertop Installation | 72 | 3 | 150.00 |
| Ridgeline Bath Remodel Installation | 72 | 3 | 150.00 |
| Ridgeline Roofing and Siding Installation | 72 | 3 | 200.00 |

## Notes

- The program reschedule fee is the program's figure for a customer reschedule made with less notice, or beyond the free reschedule limit.
- The materials lead time is the typical figure quoted to the customer at signing; it is a typical time, not a promised date.
- The permit column applies only to jobs that need a permit; on the carpet and hard surface flooring programs an installation date may be booked without waiting for a permit to be issued.

## Hypothetical date check

A Ridgeline Roofing and Siding Installation agreement signed on 1 June with materials received on 9 June may be installed no earlier than 19 June, 10 calendar days after the later of the two dates.
